Naga group issues 48-hour ultimatum for return of severed head amid Manipur violence

On October 10, 2026 a video showing a severed head among heavily armed militants circulated online; the headless body of Ajinbou R was taken for post-mortem after a militant attack in Manipur, and a Naga organization issued a 48-hour ultimatum demanding the return of the head, as violence in the state escalates with recent killings and ongoing Kuki-Naga tribal tensions.
